KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. fupi
   B. zito
   C. nene
   D. pana

2. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.

3. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.

4. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.

5. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.

6. When practising Anga, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Anga.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Anga.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Anga.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Anga.

7. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. watoto
   B. mitoto
   C. kitoto
   D. mato

8. When practising herufi kubwa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for herufi kubwa.
   B. Copy random text without understanding herufi kubwa.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to herufi kubwa.
   D. Use insults to “practise” herufi kubwa.

9. When practising Huyo na Hao, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Huyo na Hao.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Huyo na Hao.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Huyo na Hao.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Huyo na Hao.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain thi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Hili na Haya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Nambari 11-50 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
